title: Geometric points of a coproduct of field spectra
statement: For a field K [def-pc-field-extension] with separable closure Ksep and an indexed family of intermediate fields E, if the coproduct of their spectra is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], its geometric Ksep-points, with the action of [lem-exc-etale-field-geometric-action-continuous], are equivariantly equivalent to the disjoint union of the K-algebra embeddings of each E into Ksep.

source.place: Tag 03QR, Lemma lemma-sheaves-point; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03QR; construction of an inverse by orbit stabilizer fixed fields

proof.text: Define the map from a K-algebra embedding E i →ₐ[K] Ksep to the corresponding map of spectra followed by the i-th coproduct inclusion. Prove injectivity by evaluating at the unique point and canceling the coproduct inclusion.

For surjectivity, the unique point of Spec Ksep lies in a unique coproduct component; lift through that open immersion and use the Over condition to obtain the K-algebra embedding. The spectrum anti-equivalence proves the inverse equations.
Precomposition by the spectrum map of a Galois automorphism composes the embedding with that automorphism and preserves its component, yielding equivariance.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03QR; direct coproduct factorization and spectrum anti-equivalence

lean.statement:
theorem etaleCoproduct_embedding_points
    (K Ksep : Type u) [Field K] [Field Ksep] [Algebra K Ksep]
    [IsSepClosure K Ksep] (I : Type u) (E : I → IntermediateField K Ksep)
    [Etale (Sigma.desc (fun i : I ↦
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (E i)))))] :
    let X := Scheme.Etale.mk (Sigma.desc (fun i : I ↦
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (E i)))))
    ∃ e : ((etaleFieldPointFunctor K Ksep).obj X).obj.obj.V ≃
        (Σ i, E i →ₐ[K] Ksep),
      ∀ (g : Gal(Ksep/K)) (x : ((etaleFieldPointFunctor K Ksep).obj X).obj.obj.V),
        e (((etaleFieldPointFunctor K Ksep).obj X).obj.obj.ρ g x) =
          ⟨(e x).1, g.toAlgHom.comp (e x).2⟩
